shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la docs 2>&1 && find docs -type f -iname '*.md' | sort && echo "---all files---" && find docs -type f | sort

mkdir -p out && files=$(find docs -type f -name '*.md' | LC_ALL=C sort) && {
echo "# Documentation bundle checksum manifest"
echo "# Root: ./docs/  Algorithm: SHA-256  Files: $(echo "$files" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo "# Columns: sha256  size_bytes  line_count  path"
echo "#"
for f in $files; do
  p

mkdir -p out && find docs -type f -name '*.md' | LC_ALL=C sort > out/.filelist && printf '%s\n' "# Documentation bundle checksum manifest" "# Root: ./docs/  Algorithm: SHA-256  Files: $(wc -l < out/.filelist | tr -d ' ')" "# Columns: sha256  size_bytes  line_count  path" "#" > out/bundle-manifest.tx

shasum -a 256 docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md && wc -c -l docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/config

wc -c -l docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md
